title: Reservoir-Associated Thermal Structure Predicts Stream-Temperature Recoverability in the Jinsha and Chattahoochee Rivers
description: MIT-licensed software for detecting regulation-linked donor and memory structure with controlled stream-temperature outages in the Jinsha and Chattahoochee rivers, including an independently frozen US regulation-panel generalization test. This deposit is software only. Restricted Jinsha yearbook, CMA, and WMO/CMA observations are excluded from the public archive and are not licensed by this record.
